posts.name: Gus_Smedstad
posts.cooked:
I really screwed up my first attempt. I used Legacy’s power to play Throat Jab out of turn, and for some reason I forgot that it would wear off when Wraith got to play. So when Omnitron flipped and played Sedative Flechettes right away everyone died.

That really ticked me off no end.

Challenge Cosmic Omnitron is really grotesque. You start with all the components in play, all doing double damage, so you take a fantastic amount of damage up front. Then when you flip him - which you really must, keeping those components around is suicide - he’s going to chain play drones and his worst cards, such as the flechettes.

posts.name: Servoret
posts.cooked:
Mint, 8/7/19/15/10. I used TakeWalker’s hint about Fueled Freeze (which actually requires Bolster Allies and then an Onboard Module Installation play to get it out in round 1), then I focused on giving Tachyon as many draws and plays as possible to let me pull Hypersonic Assaults and finish with a Lightspeed Barrage/Blitz combo, which I did in round 5 despite a bunch of misplays that I didn’t want to take back in case I actually could pull off a Mint. I played three Hypersonic Assaults and one Throat Jab on rounds 1-4, so Omnitron never got to do damage after the first round and his EPEs never got to fire off. Thankfully his second Sedative Flechettes never came out; losing the +1 damage from Inspiring Presence might have caused me to lose the race.

If you can pull Fueled Freeze right away, the Adaptive Platings aren’t an issue obviously since they both can be wiped on AZ’s first turn.

posts.name: Gus_Smedstad
posts.cooked:
Finally got it on my 4th try, using the Bolster -> Onboard Module -> Fuel Freeze start. Feels like cheesing it, knowing that a particular sequence changes the card draw to get something important, but this has been so over the top brutal I don’t care.

Legacy really must play Next Evolution / Lead from the Front ASAP after the round 1 (and the first Flechette card). In game 3 I lost because I delayed that a round unintentionally. Other than that, this is all Tachyon’s show.

Wraith really needs to use her base power constantly to feed Tachyon card draws, even though she’s got stuff that’s normally more useful. Tachyon needs to draw Hypersonic Assault again, and that requires a lot of draws. Putting burst cards into Tachyon’s trash is the 2nd most important priority, higher than anything Absolute Zero, Wraith, or Bunker can do.

It’s also worth playing Research Grant and using it instead of Blitz, just because every burst card in her trash is 4-5 damage when it comes time to take down Omnitron. Once her trash burst count is Omnitron’s HP / 4, it’s time to unload with Lightspeed Barrages.

Tachyon’s Synapic Interruption is your only defense against Electropulse Explosives if she doesn’t have a Hypersonic Assault to play.

Part of the reason Wraith needn’t bother setting up is that 2x Technological Singularity is going to wipe equipment. Playing equipment is thus a low-priority task for her, something she should do only if there’s nothing else. She can freely discard equipment to feed Tachyon card draws because she’s not going to play most of it.

Bunker needs one weapon out, otherwise he shouldn’t bother with equipment either.

Absolute Zero can’t do much without the Transducer, so he has to play that. Beyond that it’s Cold Snap and Impales. The Null Point Calibration module only comes out if he’s doesn’t have one shots to play. I did do some self-healing with his cold damage instead of hitting Omnitron, just because I have a hard time letting heroes die. He did manage to make it to the end.

posts.name: Gus_Smedstad
posts.cooked:
I don't think there's any problem with using AZ's power round 1. You're trading 2 of AZ's health for 2 damage to Omnitron. Which is pretty much standard for AZ, he frequently trades health 1:1 with villain cards, mainly because he can usually get his health back later. Sure, you lose whatever Ongoing you chose, but since it comes from your deck, not your hand, all you're doing is moving a card from your draw pile to your trash.

If you're aiming to incap AZ to use his incap power, the lost health is beneficial. I didn't play it that way, but you could.

But yeah, otherwise the only other ongoing you might want to play round 1 is Pushing the Limits. I regularly play that even if I don't intend to keep it, since it replaces itself. You get a card play and an extra card draw out of it even if you lose it immediately.
